description: BankBot is a banking trojan that overlays fake login screens on top of legitimate banking apps to steal credentials. It monitors which app the user opens and serves a matching phishing screen, forwarding captured usernames and passwords to a remote server. BankBot also intercepts SMS messages to bypass two-factor authentication.

AirPush is an aggressive adware SDK bundled into repackaged and legitimate-looking apps without user disclosure. It delivers unsolicited ads through the Android notification shade, home screen shortcuts, and browser bookmarks outside of the host app. While not directly destructive, it degrades device performance and can expose users to malicious ad networks.
